comments.author: DBravo
comments.body: If you happen to be in the eastern Mediterranean and you can't get into Alexandria because you forgot to pick up a disguise, you can get this Turban at Famagusta. Use Search skill behind the altar. This may save you a sailing trip back to Tunis or Palma for a disguise item.

comments.author: OK-Roland
comments.body: Another "precious" equips (in order to enter Islamic cities(Alexandria & Algiers in this case iirc)earlier)

comments.body: Luckily, Turbans may also be purchased in Alexandria for those that are creating Jeweled turbans for development in SEA ports
